verdict.rationale: Parahelp lets ops describe support flows and policies in natural language, and the Internal Agent turns them into Customer Agent configurations (docs-1, docs-24). Guardrails add some rule-like branching: transferring enterprise-account tickets, and gating refunds over $100 behind Slack approval (docs-6, docs-7, docs-31). Flows can be tested against historical tickets and are versioned as revertable releases (docs-2, docs-26). Missing for 10: explicit step-by-step SOP or playbook authoring per issue type, documented deterministic (non-LLM) branching logic beyond guardrail conditions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
